ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central regions (~70%) contrasted by low-intensity (black) peripheral borders and internal mottling (~30%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white fields located in the central and lateral lobes; low-intensity black borders along the trailing edges; dispersed low-intensity circular pixel blobs (mottling) distributed across the interior white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation at the central bifurcation point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serration (jagged pixel-level peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep of the lobes originating from the notch and terminating in tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast dark pixel circles scattered across the high-intensity white ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned low-intensity linear marks visible in the lower-medial section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Low-intensity scarring and irregular pigmentation visible at the base of the notch and at the terminal tips of the lobes.
